reason: Establish the owner-approved immutable Scout production baseline, its content-addressed protected surface, and the mandatory CI scope gate without changing Scout runtime behavior.
expected_behavior_change: Future changes to the protected Scout surface fail CI unless a mission-specific, owner-authorized, content-addressed scope exception is present. Current owner-facing Scout behavior is unchanged.
migration_impact: None. Existing Scout browser storage is neither initialized, reseeded, migrated, nor written by this baseline gate.
rollback_plan: Revert this baseline-protection commit and redeploy the preceding known-good Pages deployment only if the new certification gate itself blocks a valid owner-authorized Scout repair.
